name: launch
title: Launch
description: A crisp product site for software and apps — hero, numbered features, a pricing table and, as its signature, a colour-coded release timeline that starts on the home page and proves the product is alive, one node per release.

tokens.--text-xl: headings in a page, the newest release
tokens.--color-rail: the line the release timeline hangs on
tokens.--color-accent: links, focus rings, the live dot
tokens.--color-new: the New tag and its node; untagged releases too
tokens.--color-improved: the Improved tag and its node
tokens.--color-fixed: the Fixed tag and its node
tokens.--tint-chip: how strongly chips and node rings take their tag color
tokens.--tint-hero: accent tint of the screenshot frame, recommended plan and closing band
tokens.--shadow-lift: the only shadow: screenshot frame, recommended plan
tokens.--card-min: narrowest card before its row wraps
tokens.--radius-l: corners of cards and the screenshot frame
tokens.--radius-pill: chips and the What's new pill (0 squares them)
